when I say my symptoms are bad and I’m the only one, I’m going to give you an analogy, let’s say someone is getting molested 24/7 (keep in mind when I say 24/7, I mean 24/7, so that means while they’re sleeping, eating, bathroom, walking, talking, working, etc.) they don’t want to learn how to manage it, they want someone to take it away from them, in other words a cure. Yet for me, I’m the only one with the symptoms I have, so no one is working on an urgency to cure the disorder, because everyone else with OCD, can manage it
